spec_match.rationale: A realistic thread: mentions with rich cards, glossary plain hints and a reactions button. The ⓘ is gated to any-pointer: coarse, with a touch-preview toggle.

interactive.rationale: A layout toggle, six invokers, working Follow toggles, counters for pseudo, fallback, hover and navigation, and a status line.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card describes exactly what the page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Fallback real <button popovertarget> elements (tabindex=-1, labelled 'fallback button', dashed) are inserted only when the box is not generated, and removed again when it is not wanted.

conformance.rationale: It backs the feature suite: box-generated / opt-in / valid-source assertions run live. 6 pass and 2 blocked with the flag. Without it, 3 pass, 3 fail and 2 blocked, which is honest.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment). Run with default flags and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, at 1280x800 and at 360x740 DPR3 touch. Every control was exercised, console, pageerror and failed requests were all zero, and overflow was 0px in every run. Flag mobile: 6/6 invokers have the pseudo, a tap counts as 'via ::interest-button', and taps on the text count as navigations. Default: 6 fallback buttons are added and open the cards.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the labelled fallback branch, and load-time asserts wait for DOMContentLoaded because the telemetry script is deferred.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only. Button background overrides also set color, and contrast is checked (accent-blue on paper is 7.86:1).

accessibility.rationale: The fallback buttons are labelled but out of the tab order (mirroring the pseudo), and the links are the keyboard path. Screen-reader announcement of the rich cards was not verified.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified on both classes. The ⓘ is hidden on desktop by default, by design, and shown via the preview toggle.

openQuestions.title: Mouse click on a <button>'s ::interest-button
openQuestions.detail: In headless 153, a mouse click on the reactions button's ⓘ did not show interest (touch tap did). Investigate whether that is a hit-testing bug or intended, and file it if it reproduces headed.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rich hovercards may contain interactive content. Gate entry/exit transitions behind prefers-reduced-motion.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The profile cards contain a real Follow toggle (aria-pressed). The fade transition only applies under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference (tap-for-hovercard).

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detection progressive enhancement css selector supports
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Feature-detect interest invokers with HTMLButtonElement.prototype.hasOwnProperty('interestForElement') and load fallbacks only when they are needed.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: That check is used for the parent feature. For the pseudo, the guidance has no recipe, so the exception is that we measure the generated box: @supports was shown to be wrong in Chrome 153 (it parses without generating).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async status with a single polite region, and size targets at least 24px (bump them up on coarse pointers).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Logs use role=log or polite regions. The pseudo and fallback buttons have min 44x44px and every other control is 44px tall.

summary: Built and self-reviewed in the same pass. Evidence is from headless Chrome 153 with and without the runtime flag. chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable, so accessibility-tree claims are unverified.
